criteria.evidence: Actual Compose scope disposal before a blocked serialized IO entry executes zero JNI allocations/use/closes; disposed retained launcher cannot allocate later.

criteria.requirement: Dispose while config.build runs under ASan/Valgrind
criteria.evidence: Unchanged actual DialogConfig.build leased-close and all128 configuration-kind builds passed Valgrind; native registry/encoding production bytes unchanged and actual current Linux native payload hash matches prior JNI artifact. 48possible/544reachable std/libtest residue preserved, no sanitizer/parent/whole-allocator claim.

criteria.requirement: Cancel each creation handoff boundary and count allocations/frees
criteria.evidence: Seven unchanged owning coroutine/JNI handoff regressions plus actual Compose cancellation inside JNI creation: exactly one successful allocation/close, zero modal entry and closed-ID rejection; creation/use/close stay in one worker finally.

Four real Compose/native sessions snapshot2->5->unlimited->1, Java parent objects and latest callback; reject overlapping launch without another ID. Three public real GTK selections retain old visible title/current result callback and return exact bytes.
First public composition SideEffect launches a genuine no-parent GTK dialog, repeatedly selecting the owned file instead of silently returning before readiness.

Closing the actual Compose window while a GTK dialog is visible cancels delivery, awaits real owning worker completion after user cancellation, and cannot relaunch. Closing real registry ID while show is visible rejects stale lookup without invalidating its existing native lease.
